map.这个站做的事很简单：把学校的活动影像、社团作品和可复用的素材收在一起，按类归档，: What this site does is simple: it gathers the school's event footage, club work and reusable material, files it by category, and records a source and a date for each item. It chases no breaking news and no trending lists. News expires; archives do not.
map.对参与的人来说，这是把「我们做过什么」写下来的地方；对还没参与的人来说，这是了解: For those who took part, it is where "what we did" gets written down; for those who have not, an entry point into what is happening at this school; for readers many years on, something that still opens.
map.站点由学生维护，内容以归档为主。照片和视频的版权属于拍摄者与所在组织。: The site is maintained by students and is primarily an archive. Copyright in photos and videos belongs to their makers and their organisations.
map.可以看全部公开内容，不需要登录；也可以用只读 WebDAV 挂到自己的设备上浏览: Can view all public content without signing in; can also mount the read-only WebDAV on their own devices.
map.用校园墙账号登录后上传照片和视频，文件放在自己的文件夹里——能改名、移动、删除的: Signs in with a Campus Wall account to upload photos and videos into their own folder; they can rename, move and delete only what they uploaded.
map.管成员、管存储（本地、WebDAV、移动云盘）、管分享链接；上传不限文件类型。: Manages members, storage (local, WebDAV, China Mobile Cloud) and share links; uploads accept any file type.
map.账号不开放注册，只能由管理员按 QQ 号手动添加；没被加进来的账号登录会被拒绝。: Accounts are not open for registration; an administrator adds them by QQ number. Accounts not on the list are refused at sign-in.
map.纯静态多页站，原生 HTML、一份 CSS、一份 JS，没有框架、没有构建期依赖: A pure static multi-page site: plain HTML, one CSS file, one JS file, no framework and no build-time dependencies; images are re-compressed at build time and pages are cached long-term by content hash.

map.图片转换、压缩、改尺寸、裁剪、加水印都在你自己的浏览器里完成，文件不上传、不留存: Conversion, compression, resizing, cropping and watermarking all happen in your own browser; files are never uploaded or kept.
map.JPG / PNG / WebP 互转，一次可以选多张。: Convert between JPG / PNG / WebP, several files at a time.
map.按体积或边长压，肉眼几乎看不出差别。: Compress by file size or edge length, with little visible difference.
map.按像素或百分比缩放，可锁比例。: Scale by pixels or percent; the ratio can be locked.
map.拖出想要的框，或直接填数值。: Drag out a box, or type the numbers.
map.按倍数或目标像素放大，分步插值更顺。: Upscale by factor or by target pixels; stepwise interpolation is smoother.
map.文字水印，位置、字号、透明度都能调。: Text watermark with adjustable position, size and opacity.
map.站外好用的图片工具，管理员维护。: Useful image tools elsewhere, maintained by the administrators.
map.按设备与用途分类的软件下载。: Software downloads sorted by device and use.
map.选择本地图片，转成 JPG / PNG / WebP 后下载。可以一次选多张。: Pick local images, convert them to JPG / PNG / WebP and download. Several at a time.
map.选择图片，或拖到这里: Choose images, or drop them here
map.JPG 不支持透明，透明区域会填成白色；GIF 动图只转第一帧。: JPG has no transparency, so transparent areas are filled white; GIF animations convert the first frame only.
map.按目标大小、目标分辨率或想减少的百分比压缩，尽量保住画质。: Compress to a target size, a target resolution or a percentage cut, holding quality where possible.
map.按百分比或像素设定尺寸，支持 JPG、PNG、WebP、GIF、SVG。: Set the size by percentage or pixels; supports JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF and SVG.
map.SVG 会按目标尺寸栅格化成 PNG；GIF 输出静态图。: SVG is rasterised to PNG at the target size; GIF output is a still image.
map.输入起点与宽高（像素）精确裁剪，预览里可以直接拖动裁剪框。: Crop precisely by entering origin, width and height in pixels, or drag the box in the preview.
map.把图片体积撑到指定大小（补零填充，画面不变），或者把分辨率放大若干倍。: Pad an image up to a target size (zero bytes appended, picture unchanged), or scale the resolution up by a factor.
map.「补到指定体积」只在原图数据尾部补零字节，PNG / JPEG 都能照常打开，画: "Pad to a size" only appends zero bytes to the end of the original data, so PNG and JPEG still open normally and the picture is unchanged; GB targets need enough memory and disk space. In resolution mode, a single edge is capped at 12000 pixels.
map.输入文字，挑位置、大小、颜色与透明度；可以铺满整张图。: Enter text and pick position, size, colour and opacity; it can tile across the whole image.
map.站外还有一批好用的图像工具，按管理员整理的清单。: More useful image tools elsewhere, per a list the administrators keep.
map.管理员会在后台添加: Administrators add entries in the dashboard
